## Page 3

Executive Summary
TFG is the fully integrated poultry and swine 
business, we have the own sale channel and 
serve good food to customers. We are the 
leader rank top 3 in poultry, swine and feed 
mill industry In Thailand and top 3 swine 
industry in Vietnam.
Key Strength
oFully integrated business : Poultry, swine, feed mills, processed food and retail shops
oStrong farm management : Biosecurity and highly experienced operator
oEfficient business model : Partnering & asset light model 
oProducts distributed : locally, nationwide and exported 
oHigh cost management efficiency : Low cost producer, low SGA to sale
oHigh quality : Export standard
oHigh profitability ration compare to peer
oExperienced team Capacity (Approximate as at 31 Dec 2025)
oFeed mill 170,000 tons/month support internal 63% external sale 37%.
oChicken  540,000 chickens/day.
oSwine in Thailand 150,000 live pigs/month, deliver to slaughterhouse 5,000 pigs/day.
oSwine in Vietnam 90,000 live pigs/month.
oRetail shop 615 stores.
Company Presentation Ye’2025
Background
oOperation poultry, swine, feed mill and retail shop in Thailand and swine farm in Vietnam.
oOperation in Thailand for 40 years and in Vietnam for 10 years. IPO SET in 2015.
oMarket rank no.3 in Thailand and Vietnam all aspect operation.
oYE 2025, the total revenue 73,359 MB  and total asset 47,848 MB. 
oCAGR 16% (2022 -2025) , ROIC 23% (2025)

## Page 18

Potential Growth & Strategy
The revenue from retail business increase  
•Retail shops operated since 2020 from 2 stores, 85 stores, 220 stores, 350 stores  
400 stores, 615 stores and 850 stores in 2020 -2026 respectively. 
•In 2025, we have 615 stores with revenue for only retail shop segment = 27,000 MB
•We have expansion retail shop to be 1,000 stores within 2 -3 years.
•Grow path on retail shop to mitigate risk for market price fluctuation.
•The retail business will be market driven more than 40% of revenue from sale in 
2026 -2027.Retail Shop Game Changer in Retail Market In Thailand
•Thailand traditional market (wet market) to be change to more commercial store
•More modernize   
•More hygiene  
•Big player producers have their own channel

## Page 19

Potential Growth & Strategy
Maintain Revenue Growth  
•Revenue CAGR for 5 years  around 16%
•In 2026, we plan revenue growth 10 -15%.  The growth will be in
1. Retail shop expansion 
2. Boost revenue per store & high margin product
3. Expansion poultry and feed business in Vietnam (Cap feed mill approx. 100,000 tons/month)
4. Volume swine sold in Vietnam increase 
•We plan to explore the new potential market in other country to diversified risk. 
•Reduce the sale of live pigs and switch to pork part 100% for sale to retail shop in order to mitigate the risks associated w ith
price fluctuations.
Control Cost and Expense
•Use solar energy for saving the electricity expense.
•Control logistic cost
•Control SG&A  to sales approx 8%, lowest in  peer agriculture in Thailand.
